tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa ye shes snang byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa ye shes snang byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog tu dang por ye shes bdud rtsi yi/ /bka' drin stsol mdzad bla mar phyag bgyis nas/ /gang gi thugs rje'i 'od zer las shar ba/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la'ang 'dud/ /ma lus rgyud sde'i chu klung kun/ /'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher 'jug pa/ /'di las grub pa'i dga' ston ni/ /mtha' yas ci yi phyir mi thob/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom zlas rnams spyi dang mthun par song nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgom par 'dod na/ 'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs gnyis bsog pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen 'gog pa bsrung 'khor sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+taṃ pra ṇa dzñā na badz+ra ban nghā nāṃ ka re mi/ dpal ldan bde rdzogs zab gsal gnyis med 'od zer ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin zhi ba bcu drug phyed cha 'bar/ /don dam snying po de ston bla ma gsum po rab/ /de la bya byed gsum mnyam pa yis rtag tu 'dud/ /dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab rgyan zhing*/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes phyag bya/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ de bzhin du 'dir pād+yaṃ/

puṣ+pe/ nghu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ ghan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dha tu/ rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ / gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ / 'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol ba dri med zla 'dras sgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*/ /sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las nges par grol gyur zhing*/ /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ / brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par rgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par sgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rang gi bar do'i ngo bo/ /oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūṃ sngon po rnams/

hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis mtha' rten pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'og tu raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ nag po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhir rab dang drwa ba/ gur dang bla re/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de'i nang du oṃ las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ pad nyi'i gdan bcu gcig dang bcas pa'o/ /'khor lo'i lte bar g.yas su gau ri dang*/ g.yon du dbang phyug gi gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po hūṃ mdzad dang*/ 'og gi rtsibs la gnod mdzes te gnyis ka yang sku mdog nag po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du shar du gshin rje mthar byed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed/ byang du bgegs mthar byed rnams so/ gzhan yang byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang*/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can be con nag po dang*/ nub byang du stobs po che mdung rtse gsum pa dang*/ steng du gtsug tor 'khod los sgyur ba ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ de lnga car yang rnam pa cha byad lhag ma hūṃ mdzad dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang hūṃ mdzad gnod mdzes mi g.yo ba 'dod rgyal rnams rol pa'i khro bo yin la/ gzhan rnams ni mi sdug pa'i nyams can te/ gshin rje mthar byed la rnam snang*/ pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thams cad la mi skyod pa re res dbu brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo zhe sdang gnas las skyes/ /gsod la rtag tu mngon brtson pa/ /bdud bzhi 'joms shing gdul dkar 'dul/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags ci nus su bzla'o/ /uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i phyir zlog ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang*/ las rgyal po mchog go /dang po la/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi khro bo yongs su gyur pa las/ saṃ las rdo rje dkar po saṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las kun tu bzang po dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ lte bar hūṃ nag po las/ sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba de'i lte bar zla ba la/ bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las/ thar ba chen po'i khang bzang gzhal yas khang rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang*/ sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che pha gu dmar pos bskor ba'i steng na gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas/ 'phyang ba'i dra ba dra phyed/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i shar bu/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba la/

rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la/ bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi phyi mtshams dang grwa bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po la rdo rjes mtshan pas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du/ bum pa bzang po dang dpag bsam gyis shing dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ sprin gyi bseb nas byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la rten pa'i ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa te/ shar du 'khor lo/ lho ru rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi'i g.yas g.yon du bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i sprin thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i khang bzang dam pa/ de'i nang gi steng 'og gi gzhi dang lha snam/ shar dkar lho ser nub dmar ljang dbus sngo ba'i nang le tshe dgu dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang*/ sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang*/

sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma'i gdan/ gzhan rnams su gdan re re ste/ ye shes kyi gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ gnyis pa rten pa bskyed pa la/ bsnyen sgrub chung ngu dang*/ bar ma gnyis so/ /dang po la/ bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan la bar snang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin yi ge 'bru gsum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul/ de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu babs/ dbus kyi gdan la gnas pa cha gnyis su gyur pa'i 'og ma/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ rnams g.yas bskor dang*/ g.yon bskor te mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dkar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha rnams g.yas bskor dang g.yon bskor te/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gsal byed brgyad cu yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dmar po brgyad cus mtshan pa/ de ltar zla ba gnyis ni me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis gcig tu gyur pa ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du hūṃ dmar po las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan pa ni/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs shing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phangs la bkod de slar 'dus nas hūṃ la thim pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/

slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hūṃ la thim/ zla ba hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i 'od can rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /oṃ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta a haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas/ yum mnyes par gyur zhing*/ rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang*/ gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste rig ma dgu phyir spros nas yum la thim pa'i rkyen gyis yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid du spyan drangs/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas gtso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dus gcig tu grub pa las 'phros pa'i 'od dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khod par gyur/

slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub sems su ro gcig tu gyur/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon te sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas/ thig ler zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ k+ṣiṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ gaṃ skaṃ saṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ/ laṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ rnams las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' drug dang*/ rdo rje ma drug dang*/ yum bzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga ste/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa rnams/ k+ṣiṃ nas hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ pad+ma nas phyir spros pa/ nam mkhar 'khod nas/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems kyi 'jug pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang*/ /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /bdag nyid dri za'i tshul du gnas pas de gzigs te/ bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa/ 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyis yab yum gnyis kyang byang chub sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phro bar gyur/

de nas glus skul ba ni/ mā ma kis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol// gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan cing thugs brtse ba/ 'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis gzhed na/ /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ / ces skul pas/ thig le de cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'i maṃ yig dmar ser du gyur/ de las byung pa'i ral gri'i yu ba la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du maṃ yig go /yang de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas rnams dang lhan cig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te maṃ yig la thim/ ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu'i mdangs can gser gyi lhun po ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/

g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo sangs/ g.yon zhal ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ rab tu 'dzum pas lha mo la gzigs shing sgros 'dzin pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ mthon 'thing dbu skra steng du bcings shing rin po che'i thor tshugs cod pan rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa dang bcas pas brgyan pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing*/ sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i dbu brgyan/ mgul brgyan/ do shal/ dpung brgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ se mo do dang ske rags te rin po che'i brgyan brgyad la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka dang*/ dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol shing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rigs sngags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu zla ba la k+ṣiṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sa snying dkar po rnam snang lta bu'o/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna ba zla ba la dz+riṃ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ lte bar yang dz+riṃ/ phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu/ sna la khaṃ/ rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa/ nam mkha'i snying po ser po rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o/ /lce la gaṃ

pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po 'od dpag med lta bu'o/ /skra mtshams kyi nang du skaṃ/ ral gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba/ sgrib sel ljang khu don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /lte bar saṃ/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ kun bzang dkar po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ / gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang hūṃ nag po/ de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bde bas mnyes/ thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu'i thugs kar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba la hūṃ sngon po'o/ / de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ mgrin pa'i nang du= ngag gi ngo bo āḥdamar po= pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gsung rdo rje dmar po 'od dpag med lta bu'i thugs khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la āḥdamar po'o/ /spyi bor rang gi lus kyi= oṃ dkar po= 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i= sku rdo rje dkar po rnam snang lta bu'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po'o/ / de gsum gyi thugs ka'i yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing*/ mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa sprul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pa/

/deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams thugs rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ rdo rje mi phyed= /deng bdag= /rdo rje gsung gi= / phyog bcur sogs gong ltar las/ rdo rje gsung = / zhes gsol ba btab pas gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed= / deng bdag= / rdo rje sku yis= /phyogs bcur= /rdo rje sku yis= / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri'i yu ba'i nang du zla ba la maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas maṃ la thim/ ral gri zla ba maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ dmar ser ro/ /thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu sgrol ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/

/gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus thams cad de ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'-i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang gi spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhing*/ sa snying la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ de dag ni yan lag bzhi chung ngu'i bskor ro/ /gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub par ma la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas sngo zhing g.yon dkar ba phyag dang po gnyis kyi gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ltag par phyed bcings shing*/ phyed sil bur grol bas sku stong khyab pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar gzhon nu lang tsho la bab cing*/ nu 'bur rgyas pa/ mnyen lcug 'khril bag chags pa'i sku mchog tu sgeg cing mdzes pa/ shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa sgyu stsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ ngharma sogs gong bzhin brjod/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dang 'khor lo'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las sa snying dkar po rnam snang lta bu zhes sbyangs te/ rna bar dz+riṃ dang rdo rje'i/ snar khaṃ dang rin po che'i/ lcer gaṃ dang pad+ma'i/ dpral bar skaṃ dang ral gri'i/ lte bar saṃ dang rdo rje'i zhes sbyor ba ni khyad par ro/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ gong bzhin las/ rigs gsum gyi gsol btab bor ba dang*/

sngags gsum 'jug tu sbrel nas brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /bzhi pa sgrub chen ni/ gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gnas su 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhes pa dang*/ rang la mi bskyod pa zhes pa'i skabs su/ yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la mi bskyod pas zhes 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsdus pa byed na 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs skabs nyid du yum yang bskyed yan lag lhag ma phyogs gcig tu byed pa dang shin tu bsdus na/ gshin rje gshed nag ltar yan lag phyi ma gsum gtso 'khor lhan cig tu byas na 'di'i sgrub pa dang mi mthun pa ltar snang ba zhig byung rung gnad gcig pa sogs kyis rung par bzhed do/ / yum gyi spyi gtsugs nas snying kha'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po rnam snang gi rang bzhin/ snying kha nas lte ba'i bar du hūṃ nag po mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin/ lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar du swā ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin/ gsang ba nas brla'i bar du āḥdamar po 'od dpag med gyi rang bzhin/ brla nas rkang ba'i bar du hā ljang khu don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin rnams nyi ma la gnas par gyur/ de rnams las byung ba'i 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang ba'i yum gyi sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ dkar po las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa āḥlas skyes pa'i ze 'brus mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes nga rgyal bya ste/ de yan chad ni dang po sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog la yang*/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi las dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa rnams/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs te/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma babs pa'i thig le maṃ yig dmar ser gyis mtshan zhing byin gyis brlab par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo thig le de yongs su gyur pa las/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha'i gdan rnams dang bcas pa'i dbus kyi gdan la/ rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir byung*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad du sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad khyad par du sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/

gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gzhal yas khang gi le tshe dgu las shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum nas/ g.yas gnyis rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rat+na dhṛka nga rgyal sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum nas/ g.yas gnyis pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ a ro lika 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum nas/ g.yas gnyis ral gri sngo sangs 'od 'phro ba dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ pradzñā dhṛka phrag dog sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la 'khod/

'di man chad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad ces pa'i tshig 'di mi brjod/ gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra ba las/ lha mo rnams rang 'od kyi yab la 'khyud pa zhes sbyor te/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang lta bu/ mo ha ra tī/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med mngon du byas/ thabs kyi phar phyin/ shar lhor zla gdan la= lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa lta bu las/ rdo rje'i gnas su ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ dwe ṣa ra tī/ chu'i khams/ byams pa tshad med pa/ smon lam gyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan la= nub byang du gos dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu/ rā ga ra tī/ me khams/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ stobs kyi phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan la= byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su/ ut+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra tī/ rlung gi khams btang snyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor/ gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su me long dmar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sems can rnams kyi gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs sbyin pa'i phar phyin la bkod/ slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi waṃ sngon po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sgra'i skye mched/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin/ lho nub tu zla gdan= /nub byang du dri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dri'i skye mched/ bzod pa'i phar phyin/ nub byang du zla gdan= byang shar du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

ro'i skye mched/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin/ byang shar du zla gdan= shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang khu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i gnas su gos kha dog sna tshogs pa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ reg bya'i skye mched/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan= shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ chos kyi skye mched/ shes rab kyi phar phyin/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan phyed bcings kyis mdzes pa/ zhal re re la spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ gzhad cing 'dzum pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba chen po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' klubs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dbu skra thor cog rin po che'i dprog zhu can/ lha mo rnams dbu skra ltag par bcings pa rnam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba dang gshegs pa gzhan gsum nyi ma'i 'od 'phro ba'o/ /yang rigs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang lha mo bcu sems skyil du byas kyang rung ngo*/ / de bzhin du sbyar te/ shar sgor gshin rjes mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje'i thob ba/ ya mān+ta kṛta/ sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud sbyangs/ dad pa'i dbang po la bkod/ slar 'dus te shar sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes rab mtha' byed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pradzñān+ta kṛta/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po la bkod/

lho sgor nyi gdan la/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu/ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ 'chi bdag gi bdud sbyangs dran pa'i dbang po la bkod/ nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje nag po kha gyes 'dzin pa/ bigh+nān+ta kṛta/ lha'i bu'i bdud sbyangs ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po la bkod/ byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang sbom zhing thung la mi sdug pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi brtsigs pa/ ha ha'i gad sbyangs drag po sgrog cing*/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing*/ stag gi lbags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ 'jog po dmar pos rna brgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul brgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing*/ stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing*/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ stobs chen pha rol gnon pa chen po sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ slar 'dus nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pradzñān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ zhes bgegs bskrad/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥ oṃ pradzñān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyer sgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu zla ba zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gtso bo'i skabs ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi zhes sogs sbyar te nga rgyal bzung la gsum gyi bar yum gyi skabs bzhin no/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ mā ma kī/ sgra rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed rnams la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ gshin rje mthar byed rnams la rnam snang*/ dri rdo rje ma la rin 'byung*/ gos dkar mo/ ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la don grub/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan zhing*/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ de dag ni bsnyen sgrub chen po bskor bzhi'o/ /da ni cho ga'i yan lag la/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsum ste/ dang po ni/ thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad bkug rang gi lus la zhugs byang chub sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le bcu/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis lha mo bcu'i lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ sa bon de rnams nyid la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las yum bzhi dang*/

mchod pa'i lha mo drug tu gyur te/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par gyur/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag la gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu tī ra badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la 'then srin g.yon pas 'bul te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags re re'i mthar yi ge 'bru gsum gsum btags pas so/ /gsum pa las rgyal po mchog ni/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul du shes par bya ste/ de la thig le rnal 'byor dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i maṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ thim pa'i rkyen gyi maṃ yig 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin thig le 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam la sems bzung zhing sems 'phro na thig le las 'od zer 'phros pas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nas/

snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyis bsdus te thig le la thim/ thim le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'bab par yun ring du bsam par bya'o/ / de la sems brtan pa ni/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la/ dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ / gnyis pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems zhu ste/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtser babs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'bru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su/ thig le phra mo ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste/ de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing*/ mthong nas dkyil 'khor du ma spros te/ 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdu ba'i spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs kar rlung dang chu dang me dang sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i maṃ gyi mthar bzlas pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi thugs kha'i oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams las/ rlung 'gro 'ong dang lhan cig rdo rje gsum rim pa pas saṃ gcig car spros/ nam mkha' gang ba'i lha mo rnams kyis 'khyud pa sogs mchod pas mnyes shing*/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas maṃ gyi 'od zer gyis bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsam la/

oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ zhes gtso bor bzlas shing*/ gzhan yang*/ oṃ āḥmañdzu badz+ra maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka aṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka hrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñā dhṛka khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra tī laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra tī maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra tī paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra tī tāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rā dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+rā baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā sa badz+rā hoḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥspar sha badz+rā khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badz+rā raṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ / dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod na rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor las sku'i rigs rnams sku rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang*/ thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thim pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur bas/ rdo rje gsum shin tu brtan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /gtor chog ni zas bzang dgu sha dang myos byed kyis brgyan pa/ bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa mdun du bshams la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan dang*/ yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dpral ba rang la stan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shar du/ bh+ruṃ las dri chen bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta aṃ gis mtshan pa/

nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ las dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ thun mong gi steng du oṃ yig dkar po 'od zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i maṃ gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te/ rang rang gi sa bon la thim rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog can gsal zhing dwangs par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa gyen du phyur ba las byung ba'i hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyi brgyan par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas bstim pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum brjod/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin dpung*/ byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ? āḥhūṃ/

de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ rā sa/ spar sha /dharma dhā tu/ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka sarba duṣ+tan sa ma ya mu dra pra bhañdza ka ma ma shan+tiṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru swāhā hūṃ zhes lan bdun gyis mi bskyod pa dang*/ badz+ra dhṛka gi gnas su lha rnams kyi mtshan so sor bcug ste lan gsum gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bya'o/ /yang na thog mar badz+ra dhṛka gi gnas su mañdzu badz+ra zhes bcug pa ni 'jam pa'i rdo rje la'o/ /mthar tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod pa phul la/ de nyid lnga pas bstod nas/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes sogs 'phrin las gzhol/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa dzaḥ zhes bkug te gong ltar gdan phul la/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyis mchod la/ thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu rdo rje'i lam nas/ lha mo'i mtsho skyes su babs pa thig le'i ngo bor gnas/ thig le de nyid cha bco lngar gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po/ shar lhor rdo rje ma dmar po/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po/

lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang khu/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po/ de'i g.yas phyogs su rdo rje sna rings dkar po/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po/ dbang po'i g.yas su rdo rje 'khyil ba dmar po/ g.yon du rdo rje 'od dkar po/ de'i yang g.yon du rdo rje mi smra ser po/ nub dang bden bral gyi bar du thags bzang ris sngon po/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha ser po/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rang rang gi mtshon cha dang rang rtags 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed pa can no/ / de nas rdo rje ma drug dang*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra yud+dha sarba duṣ+tāṃ sa ma ya mu tra pra bhañdza kaḥ ma ma shān+tiṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru hriḥdzaḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas dbang po la 'bul ba dang*/ badz+ra : bud dha [ yud+dha ] 'i gnas su/ ma ya badz+ra dang*/ badz+ra a na la dang*/ badz+ra kā la dang*/ badz+ra mu ṣa la dang*/ nā ga badz+ra dang*/ badz+ra a nā la dang*/ badz+ra shaun+ṭa dang*/ badz+ra bhai ra ba dang*/ badz+ra kro dha dang*/ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa la dang*/ badz+ra pra bha dang*/ mau na badz+ra dang*/ bai ma tsi tra dang*/ pri th+wī de ba tā zhes pa rnams bcug nas gzhan rnams la yang so sor lan gsum gsum sogs phul te/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogasabacu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi/ /shin du phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni/ /phan tshun cig gi nang du cig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug la kun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing*/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i/ /dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/

/'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ / nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong*/ /kun dang sems can kun yang 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang*/ /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ /rdo rje gtun shing rdo rjer klu dag dang*/ /rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ /rdo rje sna rings rdo rje khro bo dang*/ /rdo rje 'khyil ba rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni thag bzang ris/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang*/ /dri dang lha bshos la sogs yang dag ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di/ /so sor bzhes shing nye bar longs spyad nas/ /bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho che/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams/ /'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun/ /sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang*/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho che/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug bar/ /gnang bar mdzad cing rtag tu gtong grogs dang*/ /zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /hūṃ/ zhes pas spyi khyab tu lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bya/ de nas de thams cad kyis legs so zhes gsung bas dge ba dang*/ dngos grub ci 'dod pa stsol bar zhal gyis gzhes par bsam/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang*/ las thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ bdag ni rnam g.yengs rmugs dang le lo yis/ /sems ma 'dus dang mi gsal ma sgrub pas/ /mgon po khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba gang*/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos gzigs bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/
